skill_name: Explain the different stages of mitosis
workflow: Mitosis is the process by which cells divide to produce two identical copies of themselves. It consists of four major phases: prophase, prometaphase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase. During prophase, the chromatin of the cell condenses and the nucleus breaks down. During prometaphase, the nuclear envelope is disassembled and microtubules attach to each chromosome pair.
